facts.business: Ashapura Minechem Limited is engaged in mining, mineral processing, and logistics operations, with a focus on bauxite, bentonite, kaolin, and other industrial minerals, and has international operations in Guinea and domestic operations in India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Board of Directors and Management are confident that the Company's unique combination of geological assets, global operational footprint, proven commercial relationships and deep institutional expertise accumulated over 45 years position it to deliver FY2027 revenues comfortably ahead of FY2026 levels, with expanding operating profitability, continued deleveraging and strengthening return ratios.
The medium-term target is to further scale Guinea bauxite exports, supporting continued growth and strengthening the Ashapura's international operations and revenue mix.
All domestic business verticals are expected to deliver organic revenue growth in FY2027.
The specialty adsorbents division operating at high-capacity utilisation with solar cost advantages is targeting export market penetration in Europe and the Gulf.
The Company's strategic priority for FY2027-28 is to systematically increase the revenue contribution from specialty and value-added mineral products.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Special CBI Court found one of the Directors of the Company, guilty under the Indian Penal Code in some business transactions of the year 2010. The Karnataka High Court suspended the sentence and the matter is currently sub-judice.

key_risks: economic developments within India and the countries in which the Company conducts business
